geophysical.title: Mars Gravity Anomaly (degree 100, GSFC)
geophysical.citation: This map contains a digital representation of the Mars gravity anomalies derived from spherical harmonic coefficients of the NASA GMM-3 gravity field. Each point gives the Mars gravity anomaly  in milligals, which is the anomaly of the model gravity defined with respect to the reference ellipsoid with semi-major-axis = 3396.0 km, GM = 0.4282837285418775E+05 km**3/s**2, 1/flattening = 196.877360, and rotation rate = 7.088218066303858D-05 rad/s. The GMM3_120_ANOM_100 gravity anomaly map is computed from a truncated GMM-3 solution (from degree 2 up to degree 100). This map is in simple cylindrical projection at a resolution of 16 pixels per degree. Source data: ggmro_120_anom_100.lbl, ggmro_120_anom_100.img Date of ASU ingest: 11/18/24
geophysical.processing: WMS numerical VICAR; rotate longitude columns; source null/invalid values to NaN; nearest-cell display; fixed colour ramp, clipped at legend limits.
